analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We disclose your Personal Information with service providers and third parties, including those participating in the payment network, to help us provide Services, protect our customers from risk and fraud, market our products, and comply with legal obligations.

analysis.headline: Shares for Personalized Marketing
analysis.quote: For our PayPal customers, we may also disclose your Personal Information to Partners and Merchants that you and we interact with to help ourselves and Partners and Merchants personalize services and offers so you can have a better and more relevant experience.

analysis.headline: Shares Shopping Behavior
analysis.quote: Personal Information we disclose includes, for example, products, sizes, preferences, and styles we think you’ll like.

analysis.headline: Automated Decisions Affect You
analysis.quote: PayPal uses Automated Decision Making technology to make assessments or decisions, including related to risk, fraud and creditworthiness, where permitted and in accordance with applicable law.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: We may use Personal Information to train our artificial intelligence (AI) models that power our Services and help us deliver more secure, efficient, and personalized services.

analysis.headline: Ignores Your DNT Requests
analysis.quote: Because many of our services won’t function without tracking data, we do not respond to DNT settings.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Biometric data : Such as voice identification, photo identification, or face scans, which we may collect when you consent in the user experience to authenticate you for certain actions related to your account...

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Geolocation
analysis.quote: We collect precise geolocation data from Users while they are logged into their financial account.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for 10 Years
analysis.quote: Personal Information used for the ongoing relationship between you and PayPal is stored for the duration of the relationship plus a period of 10 years or such period as mandated by any applicable local law once our relationship comes to an end...
